graveyard entry:
Your spirit wanders into a lonely graveyard, overgrown with sickly weeds which seem to grab at your spirit as you float past them. Around you are the remains of many broken tombstones, some lying on their faces, some shattered to pieces. You can almost hear the wails of the souls trapped within each plot lamenting their fates.

In the center of the graveyard is an ancient looking mausoleum which has been worn by the effects of untold years. A sinister looking gargoyle adorns the apex of its roof; its eyes seem to follow you, and its mouth gapes with sharp stone teeth. The plaque above the door reads Ramius, Overlord of Death.
